## Checklist

- [ ] Change traces to accepted source and satisfies acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Scope excludes unrelated changes.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and security-negative cases where applicable.
- [ ] Required quality gates passed or limitations are documented.
- [ ] Docker validation ran when infrastructure/services changed.
- [ ] UI screenshots are attached when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are committed.
- [ ] Every non-exempt source file remains below 500 physical lines.
- [ ] Final diff was reviewed.
